profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM and reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, according to its most recent 10-K filing. The company offers a broad platform of customer relationship management and productivity tools, with Slack serving as a central collaboration product.

On the AI side, Salesforce maintains three tracked products. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging platform and, per the company's own site, offers features including channel and thread summarization, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, conversation translation, and workflow automation via a personal agent called Slackbot. The company describes Slack as the conversational interface for Agentforce, its broader CRM-embedded AI and agent platform, allowing Agentforce agents to operate within Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. The company states that customer data is not used to train the underlying large language models and that those models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Tableau AI, branded under the Einstein name, is a third tracked product offering natural language queries and business intelligence features with a Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts note no litigation on record. Salesforce has a presence in the Model Context Protocol registry through several third-party servers that support SOQL queries against Salesforce organizations, general Salesforce administration, and Salesforce DevOps pipeline management.
